editor.loadFailed: That audio could not be loaded. Try re-uploading it.
editor.detectFailed: Could not read the audio well enough to find sentences. Place the markers by ear.
editor.dropTitle: Drop the recording for part {{n}} here
editor.dropHint: or click to choose a file — MP3, M4A or WAV
editor.recordingFirst: The recording comes first: everything else on this part — the sentence markers students replay, and the quiz that follows them — is built on top of it.
editor.detectTitle: Find the pauses in the recording and put a marker at each sentence
editor.snapTitle: A tap lands a little late; snapping moves it back to the pause you were aiming at
editor.issueNoStart: The first {{time}} can't be reached — sentence practice starts at the first marker. Move it to 0:00.
editor.issueTooClose: Sentences {{a}} and {{b}} are only {{time}} apart — probably a double tap.
editor.issueLong: Sentence {{n}} runs {{time}} — a boundary was probably missed.
editor.noSentencesHint: Students replay one sentence at a time, and a sentence is the gap between two markers — so without these, the recording plays straight through and nothing else works.
editor.noSentencesTry: Try Detect sentences, then listen through and fix what it got wrong.
editor.removeTitle: Remove this marker (Delete) — the sentence joins the one before it
editor.how1: A marker is the start of a sentence. Everything a student does with the audio — replay it, slow it down, move on — happens between one marker and the next.
editor.how2: The first marker belongs at 0:00. Audio before it belongs to no sentence, so students never reach it.
editor.how3: Fastest way: press <k>Space</k> and tap <k>M</k> as each sentence begins — each tap moves back to the pause it belongs to. Then walk through with <k>←</k> <k>→</k> and check every sentence sounds whole. Drag a marker on the wave to move it, <k>Ctrl+Z</k> undoes.
editor.how4: Your work saves itself a moment after each change.
editor.selectHint: Select a sentence on the waveform or below it to adjust its start, listen, or remove its marker.
editor.autosaveHint: Marker edits save automatically. Undo with Ctrl+Z.

track.handleTitle: Sentence {{n}} starts here — drag to move

preview.retryHint: Click to retry. The same message is in the browser console.
preview.detailNetwork: The file could not be downloaded at all, so nothing can be said about the file itself — this is the connection to the bucket, which drops intermittently. Click to retry. ({{reason}})
preview.detailNotFound: Nothing is stored at this key. Check the audioKey's spelling and case against the object in the bucket — the path is built from it verbatim.
preview.detailForbidden: The object is there but not readable. Check that it was uploaded public-read.
preview.detailPartial: The download started but did not finish, so the file itself is probably fine. Click to retry. ({{reason}})
preview.detailZero: The object exists but is zero bytes. Re-upload it.
preview.detailTruncated: Only {{got}} of {{declared}} bytes arrived, so the transfer was cut short. That says nothing about the file itself — the stored object is the full {{declared}} bytes. Click to retry.
preview.detailNoDecoder: Downloaded {{bytes}} bytes, but this browser cannot be asked to decode them.
preview.detailFlaky: The file is fine — {{bytes}} bytes decoded to {{seconds}}s at {{rate}} Hz. The player failed to load it anyway, which means the connection dropped mid-request rather than anything being wrong with the audio. Click to retry.
preview.detailCorrupt: All {{bytes}} bytes arrived{{declared}}, and they still could not be decoded as audio. This one really is damaged or is not an mp3 — re-upload it.{{decodeNote}}
preview.decodeNote: The player reported a decode error too.

slow.title: Slow copies
slow.removeTitle: The player stretches the recording itself again
slow.hint: At 0.65× and 0.8× the player plays these instead of stretching the recording, which sounds echoey. They take a few seconds per speed and are made again whenever the recording changes.
slow.stale: These were made from an earlier recording, so the player is not using them.
slow.noWorker: This server has no audio worker (AUDIO_WORKER_URL is not set), so the player stretches the recording itself.
